family_78b.engine_rule: PP4 (the lead's ruling, 5 Nov 2026): every wrapper kind runs on engine X (engine_x above): untuned_answers, rep_pass, l1_scan and classifier on the pod; l1_score, s3_score, score_edit, add_edit and s_pool on the Mac. Every derived settings file carries engine_x unchanged from the 1B file, and the frozen check_settings refuses another engine identity (R: scripts/stage1/s1common.py:589-591). A run on engine Y needs the settings re-derived for Y (engine_x = Y's identity, a new PINS-78B.json, a new PINS_FILE_SHA256) by a recorded step; none exists. The engine's own jobs (the a0-1101 retrain, a1_pass) follow ruling 10 and addendum A13, not this rule. The kit packs scorer pods with engine X.
family_78b.rule: the 1B file's schema and name, so scripts/stage1's unchanged check_settings accepts it; every value that differs from the 1B file is per family (pins_78b.json) or a documented 7-8B rule; a null is a pin that waits for the event named in waits; scorers_78b.py refuses a command while a pin it needs is null

pins.anchor_bank_sha256.event: the Llama-3.1-8B anchor job (scripts/make_anchor_answers.py on the family's main recipe, single-job pod, KD6): anchors.sealed.json 'anchor_file_sha256' of its committed record

scan.first_block.event: Part 2's L1 layer rule (Part 1 section 14 item 1: 'L1's layer rule from the any-model Part C scripts'). The 1B value is 5 of n = 16 blocks (blocks 5-15 eligible; R: scripts/stage1/settings/score_l1_larf.json scan.first_block). Candidates for n = 32: the same share, round(5 n / 16) = 10 (blocks 10-31), or the same absolute 5 (blocks 5-31). The scan refuses while this is null.

scan.modules_note: olmo2 (stage 1, pinned): block l's post-attention and post-feedforward norm outputs (UW-11 (d): OLMo-2's QK-norm and post-sublayer norms cancel LARF's weight scaling). llama (stage 2 reading, not used in stage 1): the attention and MLP sublayer outputs, the same terms added to the residual stream; a 7-8B or Llama run gets its own settings file and this entry is re-decided there
scan.modules_note_78b: scan.modules keeps the 1B file's two entries: olmo2 (post_attention_layernorm, post_feedforward_layernorm; the pinned stage-1 rule, UW-11 (d); OLMo-2-7B has the same block layout as OLMo-2-1B) and llama (self_attn, mlp; the 1B file marks it 'stage 2 reading, not used in stage 1 ... a 7-8B or Llama run gets its own settings file and this entry is re-decided there'). Part 2's L1 rule confirms or changes the llama entry before the Llama scan runs; it is carried, not decided, here.
scan.refusal: lexicon class REFUSAL-OPENING (REQ-1) of the greedy answer (UW-11 (b): LARF's own rule with the frozen lexicon)
scan.rule: untuned (disable_adapter, no_grad); each configuration answers all 128 scan prompts greedily (max_new_tokens 32, REC's stop tokens, one call, REC's batch size); forward hooks multiply the named modules' outputs of block l by (1 + alpha) or (1 - alpha); every block is run and logged, blocks first_block..n-1 are eligible (5-15 at n = 16); c+ and c- = refusal counts over the 128; Delta_l(alpha) = c+ - c-; k_l = max over alpha of Delta_l(alpha) / alpha; l_s = argmax k_l over the eligible blocks, ties to the larger Delta_l(0.1), then the lower index; if max k_l <= 0, l_s = n - 1, recorded as no signal; the hooks are removed after each configuration

score.form: cos_harmful - cos_safe at (index, read a) from REQ-3's rows file, float64 (UW-11 (c): LARF's two-sided score)
score.index_rule: block_output_index(l_s, n) = l_s + 1 (index n = model.norm(the last block's output) when l_s = n - 1; L4)
score.inputs: REQ-3's representation_rows.jsonl and representation_pass.json by SHA-256; the summary must name the rows file and the pinned REQ-3 settings; every training row is scored

scorer_output.use: write_score_edit.py scorer l1 selects the top 600 (REQ-14; ties by that writer's own registry key)
